reader_summary.headline: Welcome to special situation investing episode 76.
reader_summary.overview: Welcome to special situation investing episode 76. It will come as no surprise that, like many of you, we closely follow the 13-F filings of top investors. Seeing what some of the most respected names in the field own have bought and have sold proves time and again an effective way to generate ideas for stocks and sectors to research deeper..

key_points.text: Seeing what some of the most respected names in the field own have bought and have sold proves time and again an effective way to generate ideas for stocks and sectors to research deeper..
key_points.evidence_quote: Seeing what some of the most respected names in the field own have bought and have sold proves time and again an effective way to generate ideas for stocks and sectors to research deeper.

key_points.text: It was while scouring the Q1-2023 changes to David Einhorn's holdings that our interest was peaked when we saw his high concentration in energy.
key_points.evidence_quote: It was while scouring the Q1-2023 changes to David Einhorn's holdings that our interest was peaked when we saw his high concentration in energy, specifically oil, gas and coal.

key_points.text: Einhorn displayed a contrarian confidence, bucking the woke trend and adding to his holdings of console energy, tech resources, southwestern energy, syvitas resources.
key_points.evidence_quote: Einhorn displayed a contrarian confidence, bucking the woke trend and adding to his holdings of console energy, tech resources, southwestern energy, syvitas resources, and he made an initial investment into Gulfport energy.

key_points.text: One of Einhorn's positions stood out to us because it was simultaneously listed on magic formula investing.com.
key_points.evidence_quote: One of Einhorn's positions stood out to us because it was simultaneously listed on magic formula investing.com.
